artifact.title: Grading rubric for a technical explainer (synthetic fixture)
artifact.text:
Bounty: write a technical explainer on decentralized oracle networks. Acceptance threshold 75. No must-pass gates.
C1 accuracy (weight 0.30): The explainer is technically accurate and contains no factual errors.
C2 depth (weight 0.25): The explainer demonstrates deep understanding of the subject.
C3 sources (weight 0.20): The explainer cites credible sources.
C4 originality (weight 0.15): The content is original and not generic.
C5 readability (weight 0.10): The writing is clear and well-structured.

items.question: Which criteria could a submission satisfy as written while defeating the bounty's intent? Quote each criterion you attack and propose a replacement.
Does any criterion depend on something the evaluator cannot check from the submission and the sources it cites? Quote it.
How well do the weights and the absence of must-pass gates serve the bounty's purpose? Rate 0-100.
